onSearch(query, { signal }) is called after a short debounce. Older requests are aborted, answers are cached so backspacing is instant, and the previous results stay on screen while the next ones load. The spinner only appears when a search takes longer than 150ms. A failed search shows its error message with a Try again row, and a search with no results offers “Did you mean” and popular categories.
